scope: Explicit candidate overlay only, never stock-source proof. Root may reuse the existing native stage only after idle-writer lease, clean base verification and byte-exact original DLL backup.

steps.required: F18_RESIDENT_TERRAIN_SUPPORT JSON failures=[] and nonzero checks; unchanged assertions; exit0; strict diagnostics
4observations and8PNGs; failures=[]; nonblank visible-v-hidden >10%; interpolation enabled; exact native snapped positions; all LOD native logs validated; exit0; strict diagnostics

steps.admission: Only after independent PASS of prior three steps and review of source changes since d36; keep previous failed evidence.
steps.required: Original guardian reward assertions and two scatter censuses; exact required markers; exit0; empty stderr and no warning/errors including deprecated instance_reset_physics_interpolation

strict_diagnostics: Never allowlist the original deprecated RenderingServer warning. Fail any script/runtime error or warning. EXTREME-level informational clipmap logs are expected stdout, not suppressed diagnostics.
native_lod_postcheck: For each camera segment, require native Snapping clipmap LOD<n> lines for every n=0..mesh_lods-1. Expected XZ=round(cameraXZ / (2^(n+1)*vertex_spacing)) * (2^(n+1)*vertex_spacing), matching pinned Terrain3DMesher::snap. Require near-step LOD0 shift and far-position shift at every LOD; return position must match initial. Inspect all visible PNGs for terrain holes/seams; do not claim visual correctness from marker alone.
admission_requirements: Fresh root native-writer lease, no competing Godot/Valheim, owned-PID/creation/path/resource supervisor.
Exact source HEAD and canonical tracked bytes in isolated candidate; preserve original DLL outside overlay and verify its known hash.
Only root may apply candidate DLL replacement and exact artifact leaf overlays after admission; source tests remain unchanged.
Fresh short isolated USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA per step; preserve outputs on failure.
Stop at first failure; no blind retries or full suite.
This specification is paired with native-supervisor; both remain NOT_ADMITTED until root lease, backup and source preflights pass.
